enMap.Vì thấy trong người không khỏe nên tôi đ: Because I didn't feel well, I went to the hospital.
enMap.Cuộc gặp với người được làm mối của anh/: How was the meeting with the person who was introduced to you?
enMap.... Khi xem ảnh thì tôi thấy là người hấ: ... When I saw the photo, the person looked attractive, but when I met them, I was disappointed.
enMap.Thứ bảy này mọi người đi leo núi, anh ch: This Saturday everyone is going mountain climbing. Will you join us?
enMap.…Xin lỗi, thứ bảy tôi có việc nên không: …Sorry, I have something to do on Saturday so I can't go.
enMap.…Nội dung phức tạp nên tôi không hiểu lắ: …The story was complicated so I didn't understand it very well.
The bus was delayed because of an accident.
enMap.Đi uống với tôi chút không?: Shall we go for a drink?
enMap.…Xin lỗi vì có việc nên tôi xin phép về: …Sorry, I have something to do, so please excuse me for leaving first.
Recently I sleep on a futon. It's very convenient.
enMap.Vì phòng chật, giường chiếm diện tích nê: Because the room is small and the bed takes up space, I gave it to a friend.
I read the letter, so I feel relieved.
I received the phone call, so I feel relieved.
I can't meet my family, so I feel sad.
I don't have friends, so I feel sad.
The question is difficult, so I don't understand.
The usage is complicated, so I don't know.
Many people died in the accident.
Many people died in the tsunami.
enMap.Vì đến bệnh viện nên tôi về lúc 5 giờ cũ: Because I'm going to the hospital, may I leave at 5 o'clock?
enMap.Vì không biết tiếng Nhật nên tôi có thể: Because I don't know Japanese, may I speak in English?
enMap.Vì đã trễ xe buýt nên tôi đã không kịp c: Because I missed the bus, I didn't make it to the appointment.
enMap.Vì đã không đọc báo nên tôi đã không biế: Because I didn't read the newspaper, I didn't know about the accident.
enMap.Mỗi ngày đều bận nên chẳng thể đi đâu ch: Because I'm busy every day, I can't go anywhere to have fun.
enMap.Ngày hôm nay vì là sinh nhật nên tôi đã: Because today is a birthday, I bought wine.
enMap.Ngày mai là ngày nghỉ nên có thể nghỉ ng: Because tomorrow is a day off, I can relax at home.
